in_marathi.name: Shayansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wisdom and strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shayansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of wisdom, strength, and destruction, is the origin of the name Shayansh. It is a unique and powerful name suitable for a child with a strong spirit and intelligent mind.
